messages.subject: unwanted emails
parts:
Dear list subscribers,

Like myself, you may have received a large number of spam messages from this list, during the last week.

I had no idea that Gmail (via Google groups) apparently allows this kind of abuse, which seems to be quite recent. As a temporary solution, I have disabled the public join to this list, and only allow subscribers via a join request.

I am now faced with a difficulty of distinguishing between real motivated requests and fake requests from spam Gmail addresses, given the number of obscure join request I have to moderate.

Should anyone have suggestions, please share your thoughts or experienes.

Best wishes,
Adrian
